title: OutputInsightRefreshResponse
description: Response (202) for POST /api/outputs/:id/insight/refresh (HEL-1743): a render of the insight Output was started and the request did not wait for the model; the result appears as lastAttempt on GET /api/outputs/:id/insight. `started` is false when a render of that Output was already in flight in this process (the caller then sees that render's attempt). Owner and editor grantees only: a viewer is 403; a stranger, an unknown id and a non-insight Output are the same 404. The optional request body {"trigger":"pin"} records the attempt with trigger pin (any other body value is 400). Rate-limited by its own limiter (INSIGHT_REFRESH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_WINDOW, default 6 per RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS).
